description: Loader floors (Beads loka-xroj): each kernel_api floor read by both kernels. A case compiles source (with edits: [file, key path, value] set before compiling; a null value deletes the key; an empty key path writes the whole file, which may be new, or with null deletes it) at kernel_api floor: the compiler and the loader accept it; at below the compiler reports compiler and the loader (the floor artifact with at_least changed and rehashed) reports loader. Every 'kernel_api (at least) 1.N' in protocol/*.schema.json has a case (test/loka/loader_floors_test.exs). Code-only floors (sampler-level, no schema text) also have cases but no coverage check. Expected values are literals, not computed by either loader. Optional without (Beads loka-59uu): more edits, added to edits, that remove only the case's own feature; with them the source compiles and loads at below, so a case another feature shadows fails.
